label: No placebo
rationale: The study has two sequential experimental dose arms of the same intrathecal cell therapy and does not describe any placebo or sham comparator. The allocation is non-randomized and both arms receive XS228CN, so the design supports no placebo control.
title: The Safety, Tolerability and Preliminary Efficacy of Derived Motor Neuron Progenitor Cells (XS228CN) in Subjects With Amyotrophic Lateral Sclerosis
